name: Pitney Bowes Inc.
summary: Pitney Bowes Inc. provides digital shipping solutions, mailing innovation, and financial services worldwide. It operates through SendTech Solutions and Presort Services segments. The SendTech Solutions segment offers physical and digital shipping and mailing technology solutions and other applications for sending, tracking, and receiving of letters, parcels and flats, as well as supplies and maintenance services. This segment also provides financing alternatives to finance other manufacturers' equipment and product purchases.
